fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: Hearts must accept the judgment
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn al-Qayyim** said:

> ***“Ibn al-Qayyim explained that true submission lies in the heart not contradicting the judgment of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Muḥākamah is not only an outward dispute. The heart must love Allah’s judgment, accept it, and yield to it.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Qayyim, Madārij as-Sālikīn, Erklärung von Taslīm und Unterwerfung unter Allah und Seinen Gesandten ﷺ.
